decisions.reason: The required relocation of the two letter photos is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, with no additional update or removal needed.
The source changes cover-letter signature handling and conditional placement of two photos, not the established full-document layout approach or spacing rules.
The source does not change font consistency, font sizing, or the unresolved in-text bolding issue.
The source does not alter the requested background treatment for the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, or last page.
Signature insertion and conditional photo relocation do not change the Blue Mesa brand identity, logo, or color requirements.
The existing full Canva editing access already supports client edits; the request to make signature insertion easy does not change access, ownership, or asset-policy state.
Moving two photos to another section if necessary does not authorize reordering the fixed RFQ sections.
The source contains no change to table inclusion, replacement count, or approved table source.
Relocating existing photos does not change required textual section content or resolve whether Section 11 belongs in the proposal.
The source does not change the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the final saved file.
The source concerns signature insertion and two photographs, not organization-chart inclusion or placement.
The one-page constraint applies specifically to the cover letter and was already established before this source Event; the overall 34-page limit and spacing policy remain unchanged.
